readback_required: Y — acknowledge clearly; other instructions may be read back or acknowledged (AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) 4.11.7.5.2)
when_used: Before engine start on request; may include delay/time.
variants: Expect start-up at {time}; start-up at own discretion is CAP UK wording
india_note: AAI Delhi MATS describes start-up approval and sequencing; game omits slot/level coordination.

readback_required: Y — acknowledge clearly; direction is material; general readback/acknowledgement rule (AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) 4.11.7.5.2)
when_used: Pushback from stand with tail/facing direction specified.
variants: Pushback approved; facing direction is a local stand procedure; UK CAA CAP 413 Ed.24 (2026) supplies worked pushback form
india_note: AAI VIDP AD 2.20 has stand-specific facing instructions; no single airport-wide direction.

readback_required: Y — acknowledge clearance; phrase itself is game-shortened
when_used: Start pushback from stand.
variants: Pushback approved; pushback facing {direction} approved
india_note: AAI practice combines push-back/start-up when applicable; no evidence 'PUSH' is spoken as a radio verb.

controller_phrase: {callsign}, taxi to holding point {holding_point}, runway {runway}, via taxiway {taxiways}
pilot_readback: Taxi to holding point {holding_point}, runway {runway}, via taxiway {taxiways}, {callsign}
readback_required: Y — acknowledge clearly; read back full runway-specific elements (AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) 4.11.7.5.1(b)); UK CAA CAP 413 Ed.24 (2026) gives full taxi route readback example
when_used: Taxi toward assigned departure runway up to a named limit.
variants: Taxi to holding point runway {runway} via {taxiways}; limit may be another position
india_note: India follows ICAO standard phraseology; call the point a holding point

controller_phrase: {callsign}, taxi to {holding_point} via taxiway {taxiways}, hold short of runway {runway}
pilot_readback: Taxi to {holding_point} via taxiway {taxiways}, hold short of runway {runway}, {callsign}
readback_required: Y — taxi instruction and explicit hold-short; hold-short requires specific acknowledgement as HOLDING SHORT
when_used: Taxi to a point before a runway
variants: without clearance to enter it.
india_note: If destination is runway holding point use 'taxi to holding point runway…'; state hold short explicitly when instructed
source_paragraph: AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) says ROGER/WILCO are insufficient; pilot must say HOLDING SHORT.

readback_required: Y — acknowledge clearly; AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) 4.11.7.5.2 says other instructions may be acknowledged; full-route readback is shown in CAP 413
when_used: After runway vacated or for repositioning.
variants: Taxi to apron / terminal / stand {stand}
india_note: AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) says remain on Tower until runway vacated unless instructed otherwise.

readback_required: Y — specific acknowledgement; ROGER/WILCO insufficient
when_used: Stop and wait at current position.
variants: Hold at {holding_point}; Hold {distance} from {position}
india_note: AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) explicitly prescribes HOLDING for hold position.

readback_required: Y — specific acknowledgment, say HOLDING SHORT; full runway identifier
when_used: At runway holding position before clearance to cross/line up.
variants: Hold short of {position}
india_note: AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) explicitly says ROGER/WILCO insufficient.
source_paragraph: AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) 12.3.4.8, note; ICAO Doc 4444 16th ed. (2016) 12.3.4.8

readback_required: Y — runway crossing clearance and runway designator
when_used: Only when explicitly cleared across runway.
variants: Cross runway {runway}; if requested, report runway vacated
india_note: AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) readback rule includes runway crossing; no implied permission.

readback_required: Y — instruction to enter runway; runway designator mandatory
when_used: Enter runway and wait for take-off clearance.
variants: Line up and wait runway {runway}; UK manual hyphenates line-up in prose but phrase is same
india_note: AAI phraseology follows ICAO; don't shorten to LINE UP alone in the radio log.

controller_phrase: {callsign}, behind {traffic} {condition}, line up and wait runway {runway}, behind
pilot_readback: Behind {traffic}, {condition}, line up and wait runway {runway}, behind, {callsign}
readback_required: Y — conditional clearances must be read back or acknowledged clearly; condition repeated
when_used: Only when both aircraft/vehicle are in sight; condition order and repeat avoid ambiguity.
variants: Condition then subject then clearance then repeat condition; e.g. Behind landing aircraft, line up and wait, behind
india_note: Indian MATS follows ICAO readback principle; conditional runway movement requires visual assurance and local authority conditions.

readback_required: Y — full clearance and runway designator
when_used: When runway and separation are available; take-off clearance sent separately.
variants: Wind may be omitted if not material/already passed; issue separately from other clearances
india_note: AAI primary rule requires readback for take-off; wind included in phrase template for game log.

controller_phrase: {callsign}, hold position, cancel take-off, I say again cancel take-off, acknowledge
readback_required: Y — repeated urgent instruction; acknowledge; exact reply shown by CAP 413
when_used: Use when aircraft has not begun takeoff and clearance must be rescinded.
variants: Runway {runway}, take off immediately or hold short of runway {runway} may be used before roll
india_note: AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) adopts ICAO phraseology; CAP gives worked examples.

controller_phrase: {callsign}, stop immediately, I say again, {callsign}, stop immediately
readback_required: Y — acknowledge immediately; phrase is repeated
when_used: Urgent stop instruction
variants: especially during take-off roll.
india_note: Stop immediately; do not substitute game keyword STOP in spoken log
source_paragraph: No India-specific transcript located; AAI uses standard phraseology per MATS ch.12.

readback_required: Y — landing clearance and runway designator
when_used: On final when runway/LSA conditions permit.
variants: Wind may be omitted if already passed; no landing clearance until relevant local conditions met
india_note: VIDP AD 2.20 procedures impose local LSA gates; readback is required by AAI MATS.

controller_phrase: {callsign}, go around, I say again, go around, acknowledge
readback_required: Y — acknowledge; urgent brief instruction
when_used: Instruct a missed approach to avert unsafe situation.
variants: If pilot initiates, report 'going around'; controller uses 'go around'
india_note: AAI says no transmissions except safety during final/landing roll; keep concise.

controller_phrase: {callsign}, vacate runway {runway} via {exit}; when vacated contact Ground {frequency}
pilot_readback: Vacate runway {runway} via {exit}, {callsign}; then 'runway vacated' when clear
readback_required: "Y — vacate instruction and runway identifier; report only when requested"
when_used: After landing
variants: direct aircraft to named exit and report/transfer when clear.
india_note: Vacate left/right or via a taxiway; do not tell aircraft to taxi until landing roll completed unless necessary
source_paragraph: AAI: remain on Tower frequency until runway vacated unless otherwise advised.

readback_required: "N for frequency transfer alone; acknowledge as locally needed. Transfer must be separate from readback-required instruction"
when_used: Transfer radio communication after leaving runway.
variants: Contact {unit} {frequency}; 'when vacated' is a conditional timing instruction
india_note: Delhi AD 2.18 lists multiple Ground and Tower channels
grade: not a single fixed unit frequency.
column10: AIP India VIDP AD 2.18 AIRAC 2026-10; AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) 12.12.1; UK CAA CAP 413 Ed.24 (2026) 4.18, 4.68

readback_required: Y — acknowledge as taxi instruction; runway/limit elements must be repeated
when_used: Resume taxi after hold/give-way or issue a revised clearance limit.
variants: Continue taxi; taxi to {point}; do not use CONTINUE alone if route/limit changes
india_note: AAI phraseology list distinguishes HOLD POSITION and HOLD SHORT; resumption should specify clearance limit.

readback_required: Y — acknowledge so compliance is clear; runway readback rules apply if runway involved
when_used: Yield to identified aircraft/vehicle at an identified point.
variants: Specify traffic clearly; do not use only 'give way'
india_note: AAI list of other instructions should be acknowledged; no frequency for Delhi-specific examples found.

readback_required: Y — acknowledge; any runway instructions remain full readback
when_used: Follow a specific aircraft/vehicle with sufficient identity and clearance limit.
variants: Follow {callsign/type} on route; include 'hold short' if applicable
india_note: AAI standard phraseology follows Doc 4444; local traffic descriptions aren't available from static AIP.

readback_required: N — report, not clearance; respond with line-up/hold instruction as appropriate
when_used: At holding point after checks complete.
variants: Report ready for departure; don't confuse report with line-up or take-off clearance
india_note: AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) follows standard phraseology; UK CAA CAP 413 Ed.24 (2026) provides worked exchange.

readback_required: N — report/position message; required only when requested or local procedure requires
when_used: Pilot confirms entire aircraft is beyond relevant runway holding position.
variants: Runway vacated; then contact Ground if directed
india_note: AAI MATS Part 1 Ed.7 (2025) 12.12.1: remain on Tower until runway vacated unless otherwise advised.
